title: MapLayer
description: A universal georeferenced map layer that can be raster (e.g. a GeoTIFF: Soil Organic Matter, NDVI, elevation) OR vector (points, lines, polygons, or many features). Carries the layer type, acquisition time, CRS, bounds, per-layer statistics and optional rendering style, and references the underlying file blob (fileRef → a File/MediaAsset) — vector layers may instead inline small GeoJSON in `features`. Kept generic (not field-specific): the subject it describes is linked via `subjectRef`/`subjectExternalId`. The `dataType` discriminator drives which fields are required.

geometryType.description: For vector layers: the geometry kind (or 'collection' for mixed / many features).

layerType.description: What the layer represents, e.g. { name: 'Soil Organic Matter', dataType: 'raster' }.

subjectRef.description: w3ds:// reference to what this layer describes (a LogicalField, parcel, region, asset, …). Generic on purpose.

subjectExternalId.description: The producing service's own subject id, when there is no w3ds subject ref.

fileRef.description: w3ds:// reference to the layer's file blob — a GeoTIFF/COG for raster, or GeoJSON/GeoPackage/FlatGeobuf for large vector.

features.description: Inline GeoJSON for small vector layers (a Geometry, Feature, or FeatureCollection). Large vector data should use fileRef instead.

previewRef.description: Optional w3ds:// reference to a rendered preview (e.g. a coloured PNG).

bbox.description: Bounds in the layer CRS: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY].

bbox4326.description: Convenience WGS84 bounds [west, south, east, north] for map overlay.

statistics.description: Per-layer summary (raster pixel stats or vector attribute stats).

style.description: Optional rendering hints — raster: { ramp, min, max }; vector: { stroke, fill, weight, radius }.
